name: Inbox — Conversation
primary_task: Read the conversation context and reply (or triage) with a POST + 303.
secondary_tasks: Open a conversation from the inbox list
visual_vocabulary: List two-line (message items in a thread)
accessibility: Avatar aria-hidden (requester name in visible text)
Item status = badge label + tone, never color-only
Reply is a native <form> with <label for>
aria-live toast region for transient feedback
content_rules: Reply button is an action verb (Send)
Empty = message + real CTA (Back to inbox)
Errors say what + how to resolve

server_contract.notes: GET /inbox/{conversation_id} renders the conversation page; POST /inbox/{conversation_id}/reply -> 303 with persistent banner success or 422 preserving the reply draft.

no_js_flow: Complete: the inbox list is reached by real GET links; reply is a native form POST + 303 with persistent success; 422 re-renders preserving the reply draft; refresh reloads with an inline toast; 404 renders error-state with retry.
htmx_enhancement: hx-get swaps #thread-panel on refresh (fragment + HX-Trigger loom:toast). Reply remains POST + 303 (no hx-post).
responsive_behavior: Single column, fluid max-width, no breakpoints; thread items full width; reply form wraps on narrow (flex-wrap); server-side pagination for long threads.
theme_requirements: Tokens --ui-* only; zero color literals; light/dark/forced-colors/reduced-motion by primitives.
alternatives_rejected: Toast for validation: 422 contract, persistent never transient (R-FEEDBACK-02)
Dialog for the full conversation: page = URL/back (R-OVERLAY-01)
WebSocket/live updates: no new contract; refresh is POST-only + loom:toast (P5)
Board for triage: FIFO conversation flow, not multi-lane (R-DATA-03)
rationale: Proves the Feed/thread composition (the existing WhatsApp chat pattern) under the protocol: reply as POST + 303, validation as 422, transient refresh via loom:toast, persistent success via banner. A new screen type that reuses only registry components.
